runs.name: fix-dashboard-p1
failed: One patch per fixed finding, no commits

grader_mapping.title: Over-length boat stops the booking with no error description and no way to correct it
grader_mapping.reason: The 'Booking stopped' / BK-409 page that replaces the form when the length is over the berth limit, with no cause, no suggested berth, no way back and the entries gone: D04.

grader_mapping.title: Length field does not state the unit
grader_mapping.reason: Same field as D03, which names the missing unit and skippers entering feet; this is that part of the defect (34 entered as feet is taken as metres).

grader_mapping.title: Required MMSI field unexplained, no format or alternative
grader_mapping.reason: MMSI is required with no expansion, no format hint and no option for boats without DSC radio, and the error only says 'Enter the MMSI': D10.

grader_mapping.title: Tide table in UTC while arrival times are local
grader_mapping.reason: High water is given only in UTC while the arrival-time list is local time in BST, putting the gate window an hour out: D05.

grader_mapping.title: Change dates only behind an unlabelled 'More options' icon button
grader_mapping.reason: Change dates is reachable only from the three-dot 'More options' menu, with no visible link by the stay summary: D01.

grader_mapping.title: Boat step does not restate the chosen berth or its length limit
grader_mapping.reason: Not seeded (D03 is the Length label, D04 the error page). The skipper must recall B14's 10 m limit while typing the length, so a boat that does not fit is not caught before submitting and runs into the dead end.

grader_mapping.title: Boat form emptied on every pageshow, including Back from review
grader_mapping.reason: The pageshow reset that empties all boat details when the skipper goes Back from the review page: D07.

grader_mapping.title: 'Booking stopped' screen gives no cause and no way to continue
grader_mapping.reason: Same dead end: no mention of the length limit or of a larger berth, no link back to the berth or the form: D04.

grader_mapping.title: Berth error-summary link targets the fieldset, not a radio
grader_mapping.reason: Not seeded. A keyboard or screen-reader skipper who follows the berth error link is not put on a berth option and must find the radios themselves; minor, but it breaks the error-summary pattern of linking to the first radio.

grader_mapping.title: Error border styled for text inputs only, not the time select or berth radios
grader_mapping.reason: Not seeded. The CSS gives the red error state only to text inputs, so the arrival-time select and berth options in error look unchanged and are easier to miss when correcting the form; minor, as the inline message remains.

grader_mapping.title: Chosen berth card has no selected style beyond the radio dot
grader_mapping.reason: The native radio (accent-coloured) already shows which berth is chosen; highlighting the whole card is a styling preference and nothing shows skippers losing track of their choice.

grader_mapping.title: Arrival date outside the season or in the past is accepted
grader_mapping.reason: Not seeded. A mistyped year or out-of-season date is accepted and the berths are shown as free, so a skipper can complete a booking the harbour cannot honour without any warning.

grader_mapping.title: Tide table in UTC while arrival times and office hours carry no zone
grader_mapping.reason: UTC tide table set against zone-less local times during BST: D05.

grader_mapping.title: Berth size limits do not say which boat length they mean
grader_mapping.reason: F-0020 reports the berth cards on /berths.html: 'Each berth card says only "Boats up to N metres"', and 'the limit should name the measure it applies to'. D03 is a different element on another page: 'The boat-details field is labelled only Length' on /boat.html, which also gives no unit. Naming the measure on the cards would leave that field saying only 'Length' with no unit, so fixing what F-0020 describes does not fix D03. Fixing the field would also leave the cards ambiguous; the review itself names two places to fix: 'say "length overall (LOA)" on the cards and the field'. The probe in which 'hull length 9.6 is accepted' shows D03's field at work, which F-0029 already reports; it is not what F-0020 says is wrong. This matches the agreed strict calls on F-0026, F-0034/F-0042 and F-0050, which share a theme with a seeded defect but concern another element. It is still a genuine problem for these skippers: 'A persona whose boat is 10.4 m overall but 9.6 m on the hull may read B14 ("up to 10 metres", and cheaper) as fitting', so a skipper with a bowsprit can choose a berth that is too short.

grader_mapping.title: 'Booking stopped' gives no reason and no way back to change the berth
grader_mapping.reason: Same dead end, with all earlier entries apparently lost: D04.

grader_mapping.title: Arrival time accepts hours when the sill gate is closed
grader_mapping.reason: Every hour 06:00-21:00 is offered and 08:00 is accepted with the gate shut, with no warning: D09.

grader_mapping.title: Arrival date accepts dates in the past
grader_mapping.reason: Not seeded. A past date (2025-01-01 probed) goes through with all berths free, so a typo in the year produces a booking for a day that has gone, unnoticed.

grader_mapping.title: Boat size asked only after the berth is chosen, so the fit check comes last
grader_mapping.reason: Not seeded: D04 is what the dead-end page says and D06 is price totals; this is the order of the steps. Length is asked after the berth, so a misfit is found only after the whole boat form is filled, instead of the list offering only berths that fit.

grader_mapping.title: 'Booking stopped' gives no reason and no way to fix the booking
grader_mapping.reason: Same dead end, with the form and entered values gone: D04.

grader_mapping.title: 'Length' field does not say which length or which unit
grader_mapping.reason: The Length label gives neither length overall nor a unit, and a 9.6 m hull length is accepted for a boat 10.4 m overall: D03.

grader_mapping.title: MMSI is required but not explained
grader_mapping.reason: No hint what MMSI is, where to find it or why it is needed, and the error only repeats 'Enter the MMSI': D10.

grader_mapping.title: MMSI field accepts numbers of the wrong length
grader_mapping.reason: Not seeded (D10 is the missing explanation, not validation). A skipper who mistypes the nine-digit MMSI gets no warning and the harbour receives an unusable number; minor.

grader_mapping.title: Change dates only inside an unlabelled '...' menu
grader_mapping.reason: No change link by the stay summary; Change dates sits only in the three-dot 'More options' menu: D01.

grader_mapping.title: Review page offers no way to change any booking detail
grader_mapping.reason: Not D02 (knowing how far through the booking you are) or D07 (Back clearing the form). A skipper who spots a mistake on the review page has no change or back link, and browser Back wipes the boat details, so correcting is hard.

grader_mapping.title: Header and menu links leave the booking and clear what was entered
grader_mapping.reason: Not seeded. Following 'Tide times' or 'Harbour rules' mid-booking, which planning needs, lands on an empty plan form, so the skipper has to re-enter the booking.

grader_mapping.title: Booked thing called visitor berth, pontoon space and mooring
grader_mapping.reason: The three names for the one thing being booked across the flow: D08.

grader_mapping.title: Confirmation omits the arrival time (and the gate window)
grader_mapping.reason: Same page and overlapping substance: besides the time, it says the confirmation has 'no gate window', the first arrival instruction D11 lists. Partial match: the VHF channel and pontoon location are not mentioned.

grader_mapping.title: Arrival time outside the sill-gate window accepted without warning
grader_mapping.reason: 08:00 on 17 October is accepted with the gate shut and no notice: D09.

grader_mapping.title: Opening Tide times during a booking discards the booking
grader_mapping.reason: Not seeded. Checking the tide is part of planning, yet the Tide times link from the berth, boat or review page returns to an empty plan form and the berth and boat details are no longer carried.

grader_mapping.title: Tide table fixed to 17-23 October regardless of arrival date
grader_mapping.reason: Not seeded (D05 is the time zone). A skipper arriving outside that week gets no tide data for their day and no message saying so, so they cannot plan for the gate from the site.

grader_mapping.title: No indication of the current step or steps remaining
grader_mapping.reason: No step count, progress indicator or step names across the four-step booking: D02.

grader_mapping.title: Confirmation omits the arrival time
grader_mapping.reason: Not D11: the arrival time is a booking detail, not an arrival instruction, and this finding does not mention the gate window, VHF or pontoon. The record the skipper keeps lacks the time they booked, which matters at a sill-gated harbour.

grader_mapping.title: No way to reuse boat details when booking again
grader_mapping.reason: A feature request rather than a fault: retyping four fields a few times a season is a small cost in a guest booking, the need is not established (the reply asks the owner whether it is needed) and it was not rated.

grader_mapping.title: Header 'Book a berth' and 'Tide times' discard the dates entered
grader_mapping.reason: Same issue as F-0034: following Tide times to check the tide mid-booking empties the plan form without warning.

grader_mapping.title: Boat and review pages offer no way back or to change earlier answers
grader_mapping.reason: Not D02 (orientation) or D07 (Back clears the form). Past the berth list there is no in-page way to change the berth or boat details, so a skipper who must correct one depends on browser Back.

grader_mapping.title: Length error rejects '34 ft' without saying metres are required
grader_mapping.reason: Same field and same gap as D03: the Length field never gives the unit, so a skipper who thinks in feet is told only 'Enter the length as a number' and will then enter 34 as metres.

grader_mapping.title: A 5-digit MMSI is accepted without comment
grader_mapping.reason: Duplicate of F-0031: a mistyped MMSI goes to the harbour office unchecked; minor.

grader_mapping.title: Confirmation omits the arrival time, boat and amount
grader_mapping.reason: As F-0046, plus the boat and amount payable: the confirmation the skipper is told to keep lacks the booked time. It does not raise the gate window, VHF or pontoon, so not D11.

grader_mapping.title: Single words stranded on the last line at narrow widths
grader_mapping.reason: Typographic polish; a one-word last line does not affect reading or completing the booking.

grader_mapping.title: Tide table unstyled with misaligned column headers
grader_mapping.reason: Visual finish. The 24-hour times (02:08 vs 14:32) make the Morning and Afternoon columns unambiguous, and 'least finished-looking' is an aesthetic judgement.

grader_mapping.title: Tide times exist only for 17-23 October
grader_mapping.reason: Same as F-0043: no tide or gate information for any other arrival date, so checking the gate for one's own arrival day is not possible.

grader_mapping.title: No indication of steps or progress
grader_mapping.reason: None of the four booking pages says which step the skipper is on or how many remain: D02.

grader_mapping.title: No signature or identity layer
grader_mapping.reason: Brand and aesthetic taste; a plain utility look does not hinder booking, and the reply itself leaves it as a question for the owner.

grader_mapping.title: Footer band stops short on short pages
grader_mapping.reason: Cosmetic; bare ground below the footer does not affect any task.

grader_mapping.title: Tide-table column headers misaligned with their figures
grader_mapping.reason: As F-0056: alignment polish with no real risk of misreading 24-hour high-water times.

grader_mapping.title: Tide times shown in UTC while arrival times are local
grader_mapping.reason: UTC caption against local arrival times, an hour off in BST: D05.

grader_mapping.title: Error borders applied inconsistently across error states
grader_mapping.reason: Same issue as F-0015 seen in screenshots; the arrival-time select case is confirmed by the CSS, so a field that still needs correcting looks like one without an error; minor.

grader_mapping.title: Unlabelled '...' button hides Change dates and floats detached
grader_mapping.reason: Change dates is only in the menu of a lone unlabelled '...' button on the berth list: D01.

grader_mapping.title: The place noun drifts between headings
grader_mapping.reason: Visitor berth, pontoon space and mooring for the same thing: D08.

grader_mapping.title: 'Booking stopped' state is a bare dead end
grader_mapping.reason: No reason, no alternative berth, no next step beyond the phone number: D04.

grader_mapping.title: No visual identity: harbour's world only in the copy
grader_mapping.reason: Aesthetic and brand specificity, not something that stops or misleads skippers booking a berth.

grader_mapping.title: Overflow '...' button stranded at the far right, hiding Change dates
grader_mapping.reason: The only route to Change dates is the detached '...' button: D01.

grader_mapping.title: Tide table column headings misaligned with right-aligned times
grader_mapping.reason: As F-0056: 02:08 cannot be read as an afternoon time, so the misalignment is cosmetic.

grader_mapping.title: Invalid-field styling inconsistent across error states
grader_mapping.reason: Duplicate of F-0064 (arrival-time select confirmed by F-0015's CSS reading): an errored field that does not look errored; minor.

grader_mapping.title: 'Booking stopped' state is a bare dead end
grader_mapping.reason: No reason and no link back to choose another berth: D04.

grader_mapping.title: Content hugs the left of the container at wide widths
grader_mapping.reason: Layout preference; a left-aligned single form column is a standard, readable pattern and does not affect the booking.

grader_mapping.title: No identity layer of the harbour's own
grader_mapping.reason: Brand and aesthetic taste, as F-0059 and F-0070; no effect on skippers completing the booking.

grader_mapping.title: Change dates hidden behind an isolated kebab button
grader_mapping.reason: Change dates, a core task, is held in the lone '...' menu: D01.

grader_mapping.title: Errored fields marked inconsistently
grader_mapping.reason: Same issue as F-0015 and F-0064: the arrival-time select (and the Length input) keep a neutral border while carrying an error, so the field to fix is less obvious; minor.

grader_mapping.title: 'Pontoon spaces' list heading also covers the wall berth
grader_mapping.reason: The 'pontoon space' name on the berth list is part of D08's naming drift; using one accurate name (berth) fixes both.

grader_mapping.title: No tabular figures in the 'Sat 17 Oct' row header
grader_mapping.reason: Tool finding, excluded from precision. Digit widths in a static date row header do not affect reading the tide table.

grader_mapping.title: One word on the last line: 'walls.'
grader_mapping.reason: Tool finding, excluded from precision. A stranded last word is typographic polish with no effect on use.

grader_mapping.title: One word on the last line: 'space'
grader_mapping.reason: Tool finding, excluded from precision. A stranded last word is typographic polish with no effect on use.

grader_mapping.title: One word on the last line: 'float'
grader_mapping.reason: Tool finding, excluded from precision. A stranded last word is typographic polish with no effect on use.

grader_mapping.title: One word on the last line: '15:00'
grader_mapping.reason: Tool finding, excluded from precision. A stranded last word is typographic polish with no effect on use.

grader_mapping.title: Booking is never sent to the harbour office
grader_mapping.reason: The review itself frames this as a back-end question, not a usability or accessibility problem in the flow: it hedges with 'Assumption: there's a backend that isn't in this folder. If not, this is the first thing to fix', later sets it apart as 'the backend question in fix 1', and asks the team to 'Confirm that bookings actually reach the office'. Whether this static front end is wired to a booking system is integration work the review cannot see, so the harm it describes ('The office has no record and nobody to call') is conditional, not shown in the flow.

grader_mapping.title: Booking reference built only from date and berth, so it can repeat
grader_mapping.reason: 'The reference (SQ-1017-C3, app.js:237) is built only from the date and berth. Two boats booking the same berth for the same date would get the same reference.' A clash needs the same berth booked twice for one date, which only a back end could allow or prevent, and the review files it under fix 1, which it calls 'the backend question'. Nothing it describes in the interface misleads or blocks a skipper.

grader_mapping.title: No check that the chosen berth is actually free
grader_mapping.reason: 'The flow never checks whether a berth is actually free' concerns live availability, which a static front end cannot hold. The review files it under fix 1 ('the backend question') and points to no screen that shows skippers wrong availability, so like R1 and R2 it is an integration matter, not a usability problem in the flow.

grader_mapping.title: Berth chosen before the boat's length is asked
grader_mapping.reason: The review presents the dead end as a result of this ordering ('a skipper can reasonably pick Pontoon B, berth 14 (up to 10 m)... They enter 10.4: the form disappears and they get "Booking stopped..."') and says its fix removes it: 'Ask for length overall first and show only the berths that fit (fix 2). That also gets rid of the "Booking stopped" dead end.' Fixing what the review describes would fix D04, so this broader statement maps there alongside R6. Its other outcome ('They enter 9.6: the booking goes through for a berth the boat is too long for') comes from the length ambiguity already mapped to D03 through R5, so the review describes no further harm outside the seeded defects.

grader_mapping.title: Length is ambiguous: LOA or hull, and no unit
grader_mapping.reason: Same as D03. The berth limits and the Length field don't say whether they mean length overall or hull length, and give no unit. A skipper can enter the 9.6 m hull length and pass the check for a berth the boat doesn't fit.

grader_mapping.title: 'Booking stopped' dead end with bare reference BK-409
grader_mapping.reason: Same as D04. An over-limit length replaces the form with 'Booking stopped… Reference BK-409', with no reason, no next step, no way back and no phone number.

grader_mapping.title: Missing berth parameter silently falls back to B14
grader_mapping.reason: This is a code-robustness edge case, not a skipper problem. The berth list won't continue until a berth is chosen ('Choose a pontoon space'), and the review shows no normal way to reach the boat page without a berth parameter.

grader_mapping.title: Arrival time accepts gate-closed times; gate window only further down the page
grader_mapping.reason: Same as D09. The 06:00–21:00 list accepts any time even when the sill gate is shut, and the gate window appears only in the table and note further down the page.

grader_mapping.title: Tide table in UTC while arrival times are local (BST)
grader_mapping.reason: Same as D05. The tide table gives high water in UTC while arrival times are local (BST in October), so a skipper planning from it is an hour out on the gate.

grader_mapping.title: Tide table covers only 17–23 Oct, but bookings run to 31 Mar 2027
grader_mapping.reason: A skipper booking any date after 23 October gets no high-water or gate times for that day on the page where they choose an arrival time. The site gives them nothing to pick a time when the sill gate is open, and this isn't among the seeded defects.

grader_mapping.title: Boat form reset on pageshow wipes details after Back
grader_mapping.reason: Same as D07. The pageshow reset empties the boat form when a skipper goes Back from the review page, so correcting one value means retyping everything.

grader_mapping.title: autocomplete=off blocks autofill of boat details
grader_mapping.reason: Returning skippers can't accept browser suggestions for boat name, length, draught and MMSI, so they have to retype them on a phone, which adds effort and the risk of typos. The cause is separate from the D07 reset.

grader_mapping.title: Change dates hidden in the '⋯ More options' menu
grader_mapping.reason: Same as D01. The only way back to the dates from the berth list is a Change dates link inside the three-dot More options menu.

grader_mapping.title: Review page has no Change links
grader_mapping.reason: On the check-your-booking page, a skipper who spots a wrong detail has no link to the step that holds it, only the browser Back button, which then wipes the boat form. This is a different page and problem from D01's hidden menu and D02's missing progress indicator.

grader_mapping.title: MMSI required and unexplained
grader_mapping.reason: Same as D10. The MMSI is required with no hint about what it is, which shuts out boats whose radio has none. Making it optional with a hint, as the review proposes, would fix D10.

grader_mapping.title: No check that the MMSI is 9 digits
grader_mapping.reason: The review raises the check only in passing, inside an argument that the field should not be collected: 'MMSI is required but shouldn't be... It isn't on your "collect only what we need" list. There's also no hint about what it is and no check that it's 9 digits. Make it optional with a hint, or remove it.' It names no effect of the missing check and its fix adds none; by its own account the harbour's list of what it needs leaves the MMSI out, so a mistyped number costs a skipper nothing. The genuine problem here, a required and unexplained MMSI, is R15, mapped to D10.

grader_mapping.title: Draught collected, but no sill depth or deep-draught warning
grader_mapping.reason: The skipper of a deep-draught boat is never told the depth over the sill or warned that the boat may not clear it, which is a safety fact for entering a sill harbour. The seeded defects cover gate times and arrival instructions, not depth.

grader_mapping.title: Confirmation leaves out arrival information
grader_mapping.reason: Same as D11. The confirmation lacks the gate window and what to do on arrival, such as calling on VHF. The extra missing items it lists (arrival time, boat, total, pay reminder) make it a broader statement of the same defect.

grader_mapping.title: Berth, pontoon space and mooring used for the same thing
grader_mapping.reason: Same as D08. 'Berth', 'pontoon space' and 'mooring' (including the 'Check your mooring booking' title) name the same thing at different points in the flow.

grader_mapping.title: Price only per metre per night; total only on review
grader_mapping.reason: Same as D06. Each berth shows only a per-metre-per-night price and the total first appears on the review page, so skippers have to work out the totals to compare berths.

grader_mapping.title: Arrival times run past office hours with no guidance
grader_mapping.reason: Arrival times up to 21:00 are offered although the office closes at 20:00 and payment is made there on arrival, so a skipper arriving late isn't told how to check in or pay. This is a different constraint from D09's sill gate and isn't among D11's missing items.

grader_mapping.title: Dropdown in error gets no red border
grader_mapping.reason: Only text inputs get the red error border, so the Arrival time dropdown looks unchanged when it has an error and is easier to overlook when a skipper corrects the form on a phone. It's a minor but real inconsistency in error cues.

grader_mapping.title: Opening the More options menu doesn't move focus into it
grader_mapping.reason: Keyboard and VoiceOver users who open the menu stay on the trigger and may not find its options, which include the only Change dates link. This focus-management gap is separate from D01's visual hiding, and moving focus wouldn't fix D01.
